caveats: TRACTABILITY DID NOT ENRICH THIS THESIS. The rows below are about other proteins; treating them as IRAK4 evidence would be the exact failure this pipeline is built to prevent.

JAK1: SUBJECT MISMATCH: this dossier measures JAK1 (P23458), NOT the thesis target IRAK4 (Q9NWZ3). The rows below are about a DIFFERENT protein and are evidence about the tractability pipeline, not about this thesis's target.

TNF: single-assay dominance: FOUND — the top assay is 45.0% of all bioactivity and it measures IRAK4, not TNF. The 2,582-compound figure is a statement about that assay. assay_type is no defence: the split is B 5830 / F 617, about 90% binding, and the IRAK4 cellular assay is in the B bucket.

TNF: best potency from a characterised assay: FOUND — the headline 0.03 nM Ki (CHEMBL3640299, assay CHEMBL3705047) has the description 'Inhibition assay using TNF-alpha' and nothing else. Rejected as uncharacterised. The reported figure is instead the SPR Kd of 1.3 nM against immobilised trimer, three orders weaker and characterised.

TNF: axis_conflict: The two axes point in opposite directions and neither is wrong. RETRIEVED: zero approved small molecules against five approved biologics, and the 2,582-compound figure is not what it looks like — 45.0% of all bioactivity comes from an IRAK4 monocyte assay that measures a different protein and uses TNF only as a cellular readout. The headline 0.03 nM Ki sits behind an assay described only as 'Inhibition assay using TNF-alpha', which is unusable, so the reported potency here is the weaker but characterised SPR Kd of 1.3 nM. COMPUTED: refused. The pocket run completed but could not identify the site across the ensemble, so no volume, no D=1.6 primary and no druggability are reported here. An earlier version of this field called TNF 'the strongest pocket signal in the fixture set, exceeding JAK1 on every metric' - that superlative is WITHDRAWN 2026-08-15. It ranked targets against a calibration whose anchors did not measure their targets, and TNF's own 207 A^3 anchor was one of the compromised ones (on TNF, but zero residue overlap with its only drug-anchored pocket). Nothing in this dossier ranks TNF's pocket against another target's. The reconciliation is mechanistic, not statistical: the site is a cavity on the trimer 3-fold axis reached by displacing a subunit, so it is invisible to any preparation that takes one chain, it is occluded rather than cryptic, and its one co-crystallised ligand (307 in 2AZ5) is a known promiscuous frequent hitter. Do not average these. The live fact that settles the direction without settling the magnitude: balinatunfib (SAR441566) is an oral small molecule in clinical development that stabilises a receptor-incompetent trimer. So 'zero approved small molecules' is true and 'no small molecule can work' is false.

TNF: SUBJECT MISMATCH: this dossier measures TNF (P01375), NOT the thesis target IRAK4 (Q9NWZ3). The rows below are about a DIFFERENT protein and are evidence about the tractability pipeline, not about this thesis's target.

TNF: computed axis not emitted — the pocket run reported no volume (structure.pdb_id 2AZ5); the dossier's own caveat: No mechanism_hypothesis was supplied. The pocket is reported for the biological assembly because the site does not exist on one chain, and no pocket is asserted to be the relevant one. The interface classification is NOT destabiliser_candidate despite the mechanism being known from the literature, because no partner complex was analysed and rule 2b requires that classification be measured. WHY NO POCKET GEOMETRY IS REPORTED, despite a run that completed with every stage ok. Of the 12 site pockets found, only 2 — both on the holo entry 2AZ5 — were selected by ligand_site_jaccard. The other 10, every measurement on every apo entry, fell back to site_signature_unreliable_homooligomer. Rule 4 says values on that basis must be reported per structure and never pooled, and here is what pooling them anyway produces: a volume range of 126.9 to 809.5 A^3 and a druggability fold-range of 651.0. caveats: Known limitation (NEXT.md): per-site velocity measured on small precedent pools does not transfer cleanly to 100+ site programmes.

Cheapest modelled rescue: No biomarker relaxation works: even all-comers (100%) predicts 282 months at 85 sites. The binding constraints are elsewhere — N=340 against 189 competing trials; feasibility would need ~510 sites even without the biomarker. (reaches "none", 282 months). A what-if, not a plan.
Precedent pool: 10 completed trials, 189 currently-recruiting competitors.

MODEL LIMIT REACHED — READ THE MONTH COUNT AS A FAILURE SIGNAL, NOT A FORECAST. 189 trials are recruiting this population concurrently, and the competition model gives each one 8% of the patient pool, which divides per-site velocity by 16.1×. At this crowding the share model is extrapolating far past anything it was calibrated on (1512% of the pool "claimed" in total), so 470 months means "this design does not close in a crowded indication", not "this trial will take 39 years". Found by this pipeline run; the constant was deliberately NOT tuned to make the demo look better. Owner: the forecaster (Abhishek).

keyNumbers.basis: Across precedent RA trials, activity-level thresholds (tender/swollen joints, CRP/ESR), prior biologic exposure exclusions, and stable background therapy/steroid dose requirements are recurring filters that would exclude a sizable share of seropositive MTX-IR patients even after the biomarker requirement is met. Combining these compounding filters (each retaining roughly 60-85%) yields an overall pass-rate multiplier of about 0.35. Drivers: active disease thresholds (tender/swollen joint counts, CRP/ESR elevation) exclude many MTX-IR patients who are only mildly active; prior biologic/TNF exposure and non-response exclusions remove a substantial fraction of inadequate-responders; stable background therapy requirements (DMARD/steroid dose stability for 4-12 weeks) and steroid dose caps (≤10mg/day) exclude unstable or higher-dose patients; general eligibility restrictions (age limits, exclusion of other rheumatic disease, recent major surgery, active infection) remove additional patients. Cited: NCT01061736, NCT00810836, NCT01194414, NCT01416493, NCT00563849.

verdict.headline: All 7 stations ran: a real evidence graph became a hypothesis, the hypothesis became a validated IndicationThesis, the thesis was scored for recruitability against real ClinicalTrials.gov precedent, and the recruitment delay was priced. AND ONE STATION HIT ITS OWN MODEL LIMIT: the recruitment forecast fired its crowding alarm, so its month count is a failure signal about the design, not a schedule — the panel says why, and no constant was tuned to hide it. WHAT IS NOT REAL HERE, station by station: the thesis's population and endpoint are ASSUMED by an analyst frame (a literature graph has no epidemiology); the tractability station is SUBJECT-MISMATCHED — both committed dossiers measure JAK1 and TNF, not IRAK4, so its rows are quarantined and enrich nothing; the economics station is SYNTHETIC and the engine stamps its own run NOT_DECISION_GRADE. Labels present in this chain: ASSUMED, NOT_DECISION_GRADE, SIMULATED, SUBJECT_MISMATCH, SYNTHETIC. Last number: Median rNPV (P50) = -23,480,448 USD.
